title: Entrepreneur makes powerlist for seventh consecutive year
text:
Entrepreneur makes powerlist for seventh consecutive year
London-based property entrepreneur and philanthropist Yemi Edun has been named among the 100 influential people of African, African Caribbean and African
has been named among the 100 influential people of African, African Caribbean and African American heritage in the United Kingdom on the 2027 Powerlist for the seventh consecutive year.
Edun was also named a finalist for the 2026 PwC Purpose Award at the Celebration of Black Excellence Awards in recognition of his philanthropic activities, including providing mobility support to people with disabilities. The Powerlist recognises individuals of African and Caribbean heritage for their leadership, professional achievements and contributions to society.
Edun is the founder of Daniel Ford International, a London-based property advisory firm that has spent more than two decades helping clients, particularly Nigerians and other international investors, acquire and manage properties in London and surrounding areas. Beyond his business activities, he supports initiatives in mobility, education, the arts and sports through A.C. E, a philanthropic initiative established in 2020.
One of the initiative’s key activities is the provision of wheelchairs to people with mobility challenges in memory of his late mother. Reacting to the recognition, Edun said he was honoured to be selected for the Powerlist for the seventh consecutive year, adding that the recognition underscored the importance of consistency, integrity and creating lasting value. He also expressed appreciation for his PwC Purpose Award finalist nomination, particularly the recognition of his organisation’s mobility support initiative.
Edun said professional and financial success should also be measured by the opportunities created for others and the impact made in communities. The 2027 edition is the 21st edition of the Powerlist. Edun’s selection is scheduled to be celebrated at the COBE Awards on October 30, 2026, at JW Marriott Grosvenor House in Mayfair, London.
